title: Google Ads Store Visits: An Agency Delivery Guide

facts.fact: The page says store visits are modeled estimates extrapolated from a sample and are reported at the campaign level, not as named individuals.
facts.quote: Store visits are extrapolated from a sample and reported at the campaign level, never as named individuals.

facts.fact: The page says store-visit tracking requires linking Google Business Profile and verifying every location before Google can attribute modeled visits.
facts.quote: Store-visit tracking requires linking Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business) and verifying every location before Google can attribute modeled visits.

facts.fact: The page says Google only surfaces store-visit figures when a location and campaign clear its privacy and click thresholds, with no specific threshold values given.
facts.quote: Google only surfaces the metric when a location and campaign clear its privacy and click thresholds
